findings: Fence top caps and four post caps are visually identifiable; eight inherited segments rechecked at 100% alpha>=128 material coverage. This is not species/foot/perch acceptance.
Feeder tray and roof markers sit on rendered material; seed markers indicate visible food areas only. Reach, stance, species access, feeding affordance and collision are untested.
Bench virtual root lies between feet (alpha0). Four manual foot markers lie on visible material; their projected footprint is an envelope rather than four solved ground soles.
Bench left_armrest_trial_HELD remains excluded: line crosses a gap although the separate armrest point touches visible wood.
Existing dry source surfaces remain coherent weathered wood; detailed shaded rendering and three-quarter prop perspective need common pixel-grid/camera review before runtime acceptance.
Current source composite appears visually seated on the lawn; no bird pose/contact, dynamic occlusion or physical calibration was tested.

retained_holds.wet_snow_ice_holiday_variants: not_generated; no blanket San Diego snow
retained_holds.wind: whole rigid source sprites, proposed amplitude0; no simulation or separate moving parts

requested_runtime_validation.check: Resolve canonical sprite/layer paths and digests; preserve canonical cedar_feeder/bench identities; admit fence compound row explicitly if desired.
Implement/test source-to-960x540 crop transform and native anchors; compare exact normal roots feeder[687.5,400],bench[593.75,478.125].
Confirm native scale and perspective against canonical bird/world size; 130 sourcepx/m is illustrative, not a survey.
Fit actual leg/base contacts to authored floor across full width; virtual root and occupancy envelope are not support geometry.
Subtract any admitted footprint only for its present instance; removal restores full floor; test placement through former footprint.
Validate actual canonical bird foot pose/grip, balance, beak reach and body clearance against admitted fence/feeder/bench supports; exclude held armrest segment.
Test bird traversal behind/in front of props/fence using visual masks separately from collision; confirm depth tie behavior and elevated perches.
Use actual four grounds with unchanged dry props; wet/wind/gate-open effects require separate implementation and review; snow is not a yard default.
